label: How many states
subgoals: Let state i record the matched prefix length
Count k plus one states for Moore and k for Mealy
Argue minimality from the distinct distances to an output

label: Where a mismatch goes
subgoals: Append the input to the matched prefix
Find the longest suffix of that string which is a prefix of the pattern
Move to the state numbered by its length

label: After a detection
subgoals: Apply the suffix rule from the full pattern for overlap
Restart at state zero or one for non-overlap
